text: The PNG Disaster Management Reference Handbook, published by the Center for Excellence in Disaster Management and Humanitarian Assistance in August 2025, serves as a comprehensive guide for disaster management in Papua New Guinea. It addresses the country's vulnerability to a range of natural and human-caused hazards, providing a strategic framework for coordination among national and international actors. The handbook emphasizes the importance of pre-disaster preparedness and outlines operational realities and coordination mechanisms to enhance disaster response effectiveness.
